question: Shovana Narayan, a famous Kathak dancer, received the ________ in 1992.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shovana Narayan:-**

 
 
• Shovana Narayan is a renowned Kathak dancer, who was born on 17 February 1949 in the state of West Bengal, India.
 
• Shovana Narayan has received several accolades for her contribution to the field of dance, including the Padma Shri and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.
 
• She has also been a part of several international dance festivals and has collaborated with renowned artists from across the world.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Padma Bhushan:

 
 
• The third-highest civilian honor in the Republic of India is the Padma Bhushan.
 
• It was established on January 2nd, 1954.
 
• The Indian Prime Minister appoints the Padma Awards Committee each year.
 
• Between May 1 and September 15, submissions for the prize are accepted.
 
 
 
• **Kalidas Samman:-**
 
 
• **It is a prestigious award given by the Government of Madhya Pradesh, India, to individuals who have made outstanding contributions to the field of art. **
 
• The award is named after the ancient Indian poet and playwright Kalidasa, who is considered one of the greatest writers in the Sanskrit language.
 
 
 
• **Kabir Puraskar**
 
 
• **It is a national award given by the Government of India to individuals who have made outstanding contributions to the promotion of communal, caste, and ethnic harmony. **
 
• The award is named after the 15th-century Indian poet and mystic Kabir, who was a strong advocate for social justice and religious tolerance.
